question.text: Which of the following debt management strategies involves paying off the highest interest-rate debt first?

explanation.text: The Logic: Pages 85-86 of NISM Series X-A describe the avalanche strategy as paying down the debt with the highest interest rate first, which minimises the total interest cost. The snowball strategy is described separately as starting with the debt with the smallest outstanding amount in order to build motivational momentum. The Trap: The snowball method targets the smallest balance, not the highest rate. Debt consolidation combines several debts into one loan, and a balance transfer simply moves debt to an instrument with a lower interest rate — neither is about the order in which existing debts are paid off. Note: The avalanche and snowball labels and the order-of-payment logic are taken directly from pages 85-86.
